title: Combat · Command menu and ánimas
description: The battle menu: Atacar, Habilidad, ?????, Defender and Huir, under the fighter's vitals plate and ánima pills, flanked by Q and E (L and R on a controller), which swap the active fighter's ánima: the menu sweeps, the face lights up, the theme and the skills change. Habilidad opens its skills sideways; △ / Y (I on the keyboard) shows a skill's cost and description beside it. Bernat wears no ánima and has no skills.

steps.caption: Gerard wears Noísta: Q · Matemágico · Noísta · E under his plate
Q / L: the menu sweeps while the ánima changes
Matemágico on: Gerard's own colours and interface
Matemágico's skill, Análisis Parálisis, with only its description and cost
E / R with the skills open: Noísta's No-ta slides in instead
Bernat wears no ánima: no pills, and Habilidad is off
